_comment: Who supports Chatter through GitHub Sponsors — the app reads this to put the supporter badge in front of their name in chat. It is fetched from GitHub Pages and never shipped in the app, so a new supporter needs no release. Everything but 'twitch' is written by .github/workflows/sponsors.yml; 'twitch' is filled in by hand, because GitHub has no idea which Twitch account belongs to a sponsor and nothing here may be guessed. An entry without one is simply skipped by the app. 'monthlySince' is there while a monthly sponsorship is running and says since when, which is what the badge counts the months from; 'oneTime' counts one-time sponsorships and never goes down, so sponsoring again adds to the entry rather than replacing it.
